title: Common Odoo migration audit rules
purpose: Shared migration rules plus mandatory checks captured from the user’s manual Odoo 16→20 migration notes. Presence in this catalog requires investigation; it does not by itself prove every reported change applies to every edition/module.

rules.title: Access-control CSV format and model
verification_steps: Identify the exact source and target Odoo versions and distribution.
Inspect target-version security model definitions, expected CSV filename, column names, external IDs, and loading conventions.
Compare each legacy ACL's model, groups, read/write/create/unlink semantics and references.
rules.remediation_guidance: Perform a semantic migration of the access-control records and all associated references only after the target format is verified; do not merely rename a file.

rules.title: ACL permission tokens
verification_steps: Locate the exact model and file in which each token appears.
Verify whether the token is valid in that target-version security structure.
Compare effective permissions before and after any proposed change.
rules.remediation_guidance: Keep, transform, or replace fields only according to verified target-version semantics. Never remove permission flags because a text scanner labels them legacy.

rules.title: Record rules and ir.rule references across versions
verification_steps: Resolve the exact source/target version. In versions where ir.rule exists, preserve the domain, groups and per-operation semantics.
For Odoo 20 migration, explicitly verify the unified ir.access model and convert old ir.rule records semantically if confirmed in the exact target source.
Never delete record-rule restrictions without representing their effective restrictions in the target access model.
rules.remediation_guidance: For Odoo 20, investigate the ir.access conversion path and preserve record-level restrictions; for earlier versions, retain supported ir.rule semantics.

rules.title: Group category and privilege relationships
verification_steps: Resolve the model owning category_id; do not rely on token matches.
Verify the field and group/privilege model in target source.
Review implied groups and access implications.
rules.remediation_guidance: Change only the model-specific unsupported reference, preserving intended grouping and privilege relationships.

rules.title: Security external IDs and load order
verification_steps: Check referenced model IDs, group IDs, external IDs and files exist.
Check manifest load order and dependencies.
Review multi-company and group/record-level behavior.
rules.remediation_guidance: Correct missing references and load order while preserving access behavior. Explain any change that broadens or restricts access.

rules.title: Legacy qweb manifest key
verification_steps: Inspect the exact manifest declaration and associated templates/assets.
Verify whether the key is supported or still required in the target version.
Check asset bundles and template load order.
rules.remediation_guidance: Remove or migrate the key only when target-version evidence supports the change; preserve required asset/template loading.

rules.title: industry_fsl dependency
verification_steps: Search the exact target distribution/addons for the dependency.
Determine which features use it and whether it was renamed, removed or moved.
Check any proposed replacement's dependencies and behavior.
rules.remediation_guidance: Change dependency declarations only after confirming the replacement and preserving required functionality.

rules.title: Manifest-declared file paths
detection: XML, CSV, Python, JS, CSS/SCSS, PO, JSON and other manifest file paths
verification_steps: Check paths relative to module root and target manifest section.
Check dynamic manifest expressions manually; static scanning may miss them.
Verify files are loaded in the correct order.
rules.remediation_guidance: Correct missing or misplaced paths only after checking whether they are intentionally generated or conditionally declared.

rules.title: Manifest syntax, dependencies and load order
verification_steps: Parse/inspect manifest syntax and dependencies.
Compare dependencies and asset/data conventions with target source.
Check referenced modules and records exist.
rules.remediation_guidance: Update only incompatible declarations; preserve dependency and load-order requirements.

rules.title: tree to list view migration
verification_steps: Determine whether each occurrence is an Odoo list-view declaration rather than unrelated XML/text.
Verify target-version view syntax and parent/inherited view.
Find related view_type, external IDs and references.
rules.remediation_guidance: Convert relevant view declarations and related references consistently only when required by target version.

rules.title: attrs migration
verification_steps: Parse the original domain/condition and all referenced fields.
Translate boolean grouping, operators, negation and precedence to supported target syntax.
Check behavior for empty, false, null and multi-condition cases.
rules.remediation_guidance: Rewrite expressions with equivalent logic; do not use a blanket textual replacement.

rules.title: states attribute
verification_steps: Identify whether the attribute belongs to a view, button, action or another element.
Verify target-version behavior and equivalent visibility/availability logic.
rules.remediation_guidance: Migrate only the applicable construct and preserve the original state-dependent behavior.

rules.title: Font Awesome icons
detection: fa fa-* classes and icon='fa-*' references
verification_steps: Check whether the icon and asset are supported by the target web client.
Identify a verified replacement where necessary.
Check appearance and accessibility.
rules.remediation_guidance: Replace only with a supported icon while preserving intent; do not guess Material Symbols names.

rules.title: target inline
verification_steps: Identify the action type and intended navigation behavior.
Verify supported target values and behavior in target source/docs.
rules.remediation_guidance: Use a supported target only when it preserves the intended interaction.

rules.title: report_file references
verification_steps: Resolve the model/field/API represented by the reference.
Inspect the report action and rendering behavior in target source.
Check report templates and attachment/download behavior.
rules.remediation_guidance: Change only if the specific field/API is unsupported; preserve report output and download behavior.

rules.title: virtual_available references
verification_steps: Identify the model and call site; do not assume this field is universally removed.
Search the exact Odoo 20 source for the field on that model.
Check forecast/availability semantics and dependent computations.
rules.remediation_guidance: Keep valid references; migrate only model-specific unsupported usages and preserve stock availability semantics.

rules.title: move_ids_without_package references
verification_steps: Identify the parent model and exact field definition in target source.
Check whether move_ids or another field is the valid replacement in that context.
Inspect inherited views and all call sites.
rules.remediation_guidance: Update only the verified model-specific reference and keep view behavior intact.

rules.title: Legacy stock view external ID
verification_steps: Search exact external ID in target addons source.
Identify intended view and replacement, if any.
Check inherited XPath and view architecture.
rules.remediation_guidance: Change the external ID only after finding a verified replacement; adapt XPath only as needed.

rules.title: odoo.osv imports
verification_steps: Identify the imported symbol and its usage.
Verify availability in target Odoo source and migration notes.
rules.remediation_guidance: Replace only unsupported APIs with supported equivalents while preserving domains, exceptions and behavior.

rules.title: content_disposition
verification_steps: Inspect exact import path and response construction.
Verify target-version response/download API and headers.
Check filenames, MIME types and authentication.
rules.remediation_guidance: Change only an invalid import/API; preserve download behavior and security headers.

rules.title: uom.category model
verification_steps: Identify the model relation and target model definition.
Verify model availability in the exact Odoo 20 distribution.
Inspect domains, related fields, views, data and tests.
rules.remediation_guidance: Update model references only when target source confirms a change; preserve unit categories and conversion semantics.

rules.title: product_uom field
verification_steps: Resolve the model for each occurrence.
Check whether the field is custom, inherited or defined by Odoo.
Verify field availability and expected replacement in target source.
rules.remediation_guidance: Do not globally replace product_uom; update all dependent compute methods, domains, views, reports and tests consistently.

rules.title: product_uom_id field
verification_steps: Resolve the owning model and field definition.
Check target source for that model; the name may remain valid on some models.
Review compute dependencies, conversions, rounding and call sites.
rules.remediation_guidance: Change only when unsupported on the specific model; preserve unit conversion, quantity and rounding behavior.

rules.title: Unit-of-measure semantic consistency
verification_steps: Check category compatibility, conversion factor, rounding, quantities and business logic.
Inspect ORM fields, domains, compute/inverse/onchange methods, XML, imports/exports and tests.
rules.remediation_guidance: Ensure all references are migrated consistently and unit conversion behavior remains equivalent.

rules.title: mail.tracking.value references
verification_steps: Verify target model definition, access rules and persistence semantics.
Identify whether code expects historical tracking rows or fields.
rules.remediation_guidance: Adapt only the affected usage and preserve required history and access behavior.

rules.title: account.group references
verification_steps: Verify model and external IDs in target edition and installed addons.
Check module dependencies and business logic that uses the model.
rules.remediation_guidance: Replace only if source confirms removal/change; do not assume a hierarchy-based replacement.

rules.title: hr.work.entry references
verification_steps: Verify model availability in target edition and installed modules.
Check dependencies and expected fields/methods.
rules.remediation_guidance: Update dependencies or model usage only when verified.

rules.title: Model has no table
detection: models flagged as having no database table
verification_steps: Determine whether model is regular, abstract, transient, delegated or SQL-backed.
Inspect _name, _inherit, _auto, _abstract and related model design.
rules.remediation_guidance: Do not add _auto=False solely to silence a warning; preserve intended persistence and inheritance.

rules.title: Method signatures, decorators and field behavior
detection: overridden methods, decorators, fields, compute/onchange methods
verification_steps: Compare override signatures and call patterns with Odoo 20 parent source.
Check field parameters, compute dependencies, inverse methods, constraints and access checks.
rules.remediation_guidance: Update signatures and field behavior only to match verified target APIs and preserve semantics.

rules.title: Domain and expression APIs
verification_steps: Identify exact import/API and current behavior.
Verify target replacement and test boolean composition, context and operators.
rules.remediation_guidance: Use supported target utilities while preserving domain semantics.

rules.title: Selection extension and ondelete policy
verification_steps: Locate the original selection and every extension of the field.
Check target-version requirement for ondelete for added values.
Verify each added value's lifecycle and what happens to records using it if the extension is removed.
Check other modules extending the same field.
rules.remediation_guidance: Add or revise ondelete only when required and choose behavior that fits business semantics; do not flag every selection_add as an error.

rules.title: decimal_precision
verification_steps: Determine whether the match is an import, dependency or identifier.
Verify target API and precision configuration behavior.
rules.remediation_guidance: Use the supported precision API only after confirming numeric behavior and precision semantics.

rules.title: html_keep_url
verification_steps: Verify exact import and target utility availability.
Check link preservation and sanitization behavior.
rules.remediation_guidance: Replace only with a verified equivalent; preserve safe HTML/link behavior.

rules.title: odoo.tools.pickle
detection: from odoo.tools import pickle and related imports
verification_steps: Verify exact symbol availability and how serialized data is used.
Review security implications and compatibility of stored serialized values.
rules.remediation_guidance: If unsupported, use a suitable supported API only after reviewing serialization and security implications.

rules.title: Controller route type json
detection: type='json' or type="json" in route declarations
verification_steps: Confirm the match is a route decorator and identify request/response protocol.
Verify target-version route types and authentication/CSRF behavior.
rules.remediation_guidance: Update route declaration only when required; preserve client protocol, authentication and response shape.

rules.title: web.framework and web.session
verification_steps: Inspect imports and actual usage.
Verify target web-client modules, services and registries.
rules.remediation_guidance: Replace unsupported modules with verified target APIs; preserve loading, session and error behavior.

rules.title: session.get_file
verification_steps: Inspect download parameters, authentication, error handling and call sites.
Verify target-version download API.
rules.remediation_guidance: Use supported download APIs only after matching parameters and behavior.

rules.title: blockUI and unblockUI
verification_steps: Identify all start/stop paths, exceptions and asynchronous callbacks.
Verify supported target UI service and lifecycle.
rules.remediation_guidance: Migrate to supported UI behavior and ensure cleanup on success, failure and cancellation.

rules.title: Owl components, registries and frontend assets
detection: legacy frontend imports, component APIs, registries, templates and assets
verification_steps: Compare imports, lifecycle methods, services, event handling, templates and asset bundles with target web client.
rules.remediation_guidance: Migrate only verified incompatibilities; validate frontend build and runtime behavior.

rules.title: External IDs, dependencies and inherited methods
detection: external IDs, module dependencies, inherited methods
verification_steps: Search exact target source for IDs, models, methods and dependencies.
Check override signatures and dependencies.
rules.remediation_guidance: Update references consistently and report any change outside the target module before making it.

rules.title: Syntax, XML, tests and dependency validation
detection: Python, XML, CSV, JS/SCSS, manifests and tests
verification_steps: Run safe static validation where available.
Run module tests or installation checks only in an authorized environment.
Capture commands, exit codes and relevant logs.
rules.remediation_guidance: Report only checks actually run. A successful text scan is not proof of Odoo 20 compatibility.

rules.title: Database and runtime operations are out of scope by default
detection: database reset, drop/recreate, migration, Docker volumes or runtime installation
verification_steps: Keep source migration separate from database migration.
Do not connect to live instances or require database credentials for local source scanning.
Obtain explicit approval before any requested destructive operation, naming exact target and data-loss impact.
rules.remediation_guidance: Do not perform database operations by default. The user may start Odoo manually and provide logs for follow-up.

rules.title: Odoo 20 unified access model and security CSV
verification_steps: Inspect legacy security CSV filename, header, XML records, model names and manifest references. Verify target Odoo 20 expects ir.access and security/ir.access.csv; do not preserve the old filename merely because a note says to. Translate ACL and record-rule semantics together.
Inspect the exact owning model/view/API in the source and target versions, including inherited views, manifest, dependencies, tests and callers where applicable.
Record source URL/path and relevant symbol/lines; classify as confirmed, likely, false positive, or needs investigation.
rules.remediation_guidance: Security-critical. Source evidence indicates ir.model.access and ir.rule are replaced by ir.access; the CSV filename/header also change.

Record source URL/path and relevant symbol/lines; classify as confirmed, likely, false positive, or needs investigation.

rules.title: Odoo 17+ attrs attribute conversion
rules.reported_change: Legacy attrs dictionaries must be converted to inline Python expressions for target view syntax where applicable.
verification_steps: Find every attrs attribute in XML views and determine the exact field conditions, boolean grouping, operators and referenced fields.
Convert to supported inline expressions only after checking target-version view semantics.
Record applicable/not applicable status and verify inherited-view behavior.
rules.remediation_guidance: Translate each attrs condition to inline expressions while preserving logic; do not perform regex-only conversion of nested domain syntax.

rules.title: Odoo 17+ states attribute conversion
rules.reported_change: Legacy states='draft,sent' declarations must be converted to equivalent inline visibility logic where applicable.
verification_steps: Find every states attribute and determine the original visibility/state behavior.
Convert to supported inline expressions, checking allowed states and interactions with invisible/readonly/required.
Validate inherited views and representative workflow states.
rules.remediation_guidance: Use an equivalent inline expression such as state not in (...) only after confirming the original semantics and quoting.
